provider: Westlake 02cbace (McDonald's/Burger King fixes), board native runtime of 2026-09-19 plus the source-built IME helper, source-built bionic shim with sysconf and pathconf translation, WebView input supplied, SELinux enforcing
corpus: five apps chosen for runtimes the checks have never seen: Flutter, Unity/IL2CPP, Gecko, native C/C++, and Java/Kotlin only
method: each prediction is taken from a row of that app's gap map, generated before the app was launched. The launch is scored against these without editing them.

apps.overall: does not reach its first frame

predictions.claim: libflutter.so does not load: it imports ANativeWindow_lock and ANativeWindow_unlockAndPost, which Westlake's libandroid.so does not export, and __openat_2, which musl does not have and the bionic shim does not supply
predictions.expected: blocker at startup, in System.loadLibrary from the Flutter engine's initialisation
predictions.basis: oh-resolve: 485/488 resolved, 3 missing, all imported by libflutter.so

predictions.claim: if the engine did load, the WiFi service would throw: two Kotlin non-null casts of WifiManager, which is null here
predictions.expected: not reached unless L1 is wrong

predictions.claim: no Java platform API is missing on the path
predictions.expected: no NoSuchMethodError from a platform API
predictions.basis: annotate-api-levels: 8 of 10 absences are newer than API 35, 1 absent, 1 unindexed

apps.stack: native C/C++ media engine, no splits
apps.overall: reaches its first screen when launched with the isolation the map asks for, with an empty media library

predictions.claim: launched without namespace isolation, libvlcjni.so fails to link: the APK's libc++_shared.so is shadowed by the board's copy, and four of its libraries reach it through DT_NEEDED
predictions.expected: blocker at startup, the same shape as Burger King B1
predictions.basis: load:shadowed-by-board missing, targets libc++_shared.so libmla.so libvlc.so libvlcjni.so

predictions.claim: with those four passed to --android-native-target, every native import resolves and the engine loads
the media library is empty: a runtime storage permission request reaches no permission controller
predictions.basis: not a map row; direct launch has no permission controller

predictions.claim: components declared in a second process do not start

apps.overall: reaches its first screen; opening an article takes the process down

predictions.claim: the feed renders: nothing on the startup path needs a missing native symbol, and the only unresolved one (dl_unwind_find_exidx) is imported by libmaplibre.so, which loads when a map is shown
opening an article aborts the process: article content is rendered in a WebView, whose renderer needs an isolated service process direct launch cannot start
predictions.expected: process death on the article screen

predictions.claim: a map screen fails to load its library
predictions.basis: libmaplibre.so imports dl_unwind_find_exidx, which is bionic-private and not in the shim

predictions.claim: 13 platform members the app references are absent from the boot jars and at least one is reachable from the startup path
predictions.expected: possible NoSuchMethodError or NoClassDefFoundError before the first screen

predictions.claim: libxul.so does not load: it imports AHardwareBuffer_sendHandleToUnixSocket, AHardwareBuffer_recvHandleFromUnixSocket, AImageReader and AMediaCodec entry points that the board and the staged runtime do not provide
predictions.basis: oh-resolve: 1898/1958 resolved, 60 missing, libxul.so the importer

predictions.claim: even with libxul loaded, Gecko's content process cannot start: it is an isolated service process, the same gap that stops WebView's renderer
AccessibilityNodeInfo.setChecked(I)V is referenced and absent from the boot jars at API 35
predictions.expected: NoSuchMethodError if an accessibility path runs

predictions.claim: libunity.so does not load: it imports __system_property_read, which musl does not have and the shim does not supply, and the AMEDIAFORMAT_KEY_* data symbols from libmediandk, which the runtime does not ship
predictions.basis: oh-resolve: 559/618 resolved, 59 missing, libunity.so and libnms.so the importers

predictions.claim: all 15 manifest providers are created at bind without error
Google Play services are absent, so Firebase and the ad SDKs degrade rather than crash
four Kotlin non-null casts of StorageStatsManager, and one each of WifiManager, CaptioningManager and the network service discovery manager, would throw if reached: all four services are null
predictions.expected: not reached unless S1 is wrong

what_this_tests: whether the native-symbol resolution is right about three different engines it has never seen
whether load:shadowed-by-board, written after Burger King, generalises to an unrelated app (VLC)
whether wv:renderer-process, written for Chromium, describes Gecko's content process too
whether the map is quiet on an app that should mostly work (Wikipedia's first screen)
